repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a rising-edge wait on MotionSensor.Motion. The candidate incorrectly polls the condition at the start of the body (line 3) and uses a hold counter (lines 5-6) to emulate the wait. Evidence F2 shows the motion signal went true at t=100ms, but the candidate emitted no action because the `if` guard was evaluated at t=0 (when motion was false) and the rising edge occurred between iterations. The correct shape requires blocking on the rising edge before the action.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the polling/hold-counter pattern with a blocking `wait until` for the rising edge, followed immediately by the action. This ensures the action fires exactly when the edge occurs, matching the IR's `wait(cond, rising)` semantics.
